summary: Cintas Corp filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of a Second Request from the FTC under the HSR Act regarding its pending acquisition of UniFirst Corporation via a two-step merger. The Merger Agreement, entered March 10, 2026, provides for Merger Sub Inc. to merge into UniFirst, followed by a second merger into Merger Sub LLC. On June 12, 2026, UniFirst shareholders voted to approve the deal. The HSR waiting period is extended until 30 days after both parties substantially comply with the Second Request. Cintas expects closing in H2 2026, pending regulatory approvals. The risk-arb angle focuses on antitrust clearance timing and potential remedies.
